latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release with full-featured cloud captioning workflow for DaVinci Resolve users:

- Upload video files (MP4, MOV, AVI, MKV, up to 500MB) for fast, server-side caption generation and burn-in.
- Easy setup: automatic anonymous authentication and session creation with free trial credits.
- Simple prompt-based interface—just tell it to generate captions and export video.
- Clear guidance and error handling for uploads, exporting, credits, file formats, and common issues.
- Supports interactive workflows: uploads, caption generate/burn-in, 1080p MP4 export, and timeline previews.
- All rendering and edits are processed remotely; no DaVinci Resolve plugin or local install required.
